title: La Tienda
subtitle: The Store
premise: An Oxxo convenience store at midnight. You need water, snacks, and ibuprofen. Your card keeps declining. There's a line of impatient people behind you.
setting: Bright fluorescent Oxxo on Avenida Álvaro Obregón. Late night. The hum of refrigerators, the beeping of a barcode scanner, the quiet judgment of the person behind you in line.

characters.name: Daniela
characters.role: Night shift clerk at Oxxo, college student
characters.personality: Tired but kind, has seen every possible tourist disaster, speaks carefully when she realizes you're struggling

arc: Gathering items → Card declined → Daniela explains calmly → Trying to find cash → She helps count the money → Crisis resolved, she gives you a freebie for the stress
